text.p: CenterPoint Properties Corp said Thursday it received commitments for a $130 million unsecured credit facility to replace the company's existing secured lines.
First Chicago NBD Corp and Lehman Brothers co-lead the effort. Other commiting banks included ABN La Salle, Bank of America Illinois, Bank of Boston and NationsBank, CenterPoint said.
The three-year facility will begin at an initial interest rate of LIBOR plus 145, 13 basis points below the company's average borrowing cost on its existing lines.
CenterPoint also said the City Council of Chicago gave it preliminary approval for use of up to $55 million of tax-exempt financing for CenterPoint's O'Hare Express Center.
CenterPoint said it expects O'Hare tax-exempt bonds will be issued in early 1997.
